I would like to establish what the construct validity of the scale is before investigating the interaction effect of CC. In order to do so, I specified the model below:

> PModel5 <-'
+ CC =~ CC1 + CC2 + CC3 + CC4 + CC5 + CC6
+ '
> fit.PModel5 <- cfa(PModel5, data = mydata, estimator = "WLSMV", ordered = c("CC1","CC2","CC3","CC4","CC5","CC6"))

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Warning in lavaan: Confirmatory factor analysis with WLSMV
parts: the standard errors are not reported in the output under the column variances, as indicated below.
Those are not estimated parameters, so they do not have estimated standard errors.
I seem to be getting the same error, irrespective of the scale I investigate.

It is not an error, it is a warning.  Notice in your descriptive statistics how few observations you have in the lowest 2 categories?  Unless you have a sample size in the millions, this warning message is unavoidable because you cannot possibly observe all possible response combinations. 

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam

http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/10705510701758406
